reasoning_evidence: As of Jul 2026 the site is in earthwork/clearing stage; road grid established, rectangular pads being graded; no racking or electrical work visible at 10 m/px resolution

From earthwork-start (~Q1–Q2 2026) to COD for a 600 MW solar project typically requires 18–24 months (civil, foundations, racking, collection, substation, commissioning); reported 2027-07-06 implies ~14–16 months — aggressive but feasible with strong developer execution

IA Exhibit B gives relative schedule: In-Service +26 months, COD +28 months from conditions precedent satisfaction; 'Meets all 6.9' date is 2026-04-21 (likely the final gate) → if anchored there, contractual COD = ~Aug 2028; if anchored to IA execution (Sep 2024), contractual COD = ~Jan 2027 — this ambiguity is material
Queue-history: 2 reported-COD changes (2027-07-06 → 2027-06-01 → 2027-07-06), capacity downscaled 25% in Aug 2025 (809.6 → 603.59 MW) — project resized mid-development

Positive signals: ENGIE developer, Meta PPA signed ($900M scale), $23M financial security posted, Stonewall County 10-yr abatement approved April 2025, FIS approved Jan 2026, meets all 6.9 milestones April 2026
Risk factors: EPC not identified, no NTP/financing-close announcement, IA relative schedule anchor ambiguous, 25% capacity downsize may indicate design changes that affect schedule
